name: Ánle
text: Ánle is the Old Irish variant spelling of Ainnle. MacKillop records the older form as one of the attested spellings of the warrior name from the Ulster cycle. The principal record sits under Ainnle headword.

attributes.attribute: Old Irish variant of Ainnle; pointer to Ainnle headword

okr.objective: Ánle is a MacKillop signpost to Ainnle.
key_results: Cites Ainnle as the canonical headword.
Old Irish spelling of the Ulster cycle warrior.
